# Catholic Online

> > World's Catholic Library providing comprehensive resources on saints, prayers, liturgical seasons, and Catholic education.

Catholic Online serves as a central hub for Catholic faith resources, featuring extensive libraries on saints like St. Francis of Assisi and St. Michael the Archangel, prayer resources including the Rosary, liturgical content for seasons like Lent and Holy Week, and educational materials through Catholic Online School and Learning Resources.

## Key Topics

- Saints and Holy Figures
- Prayer and Devotions
- Rosary
- Lent and Holy Week
- Easter
- Catholic Education
- Pro-Life Ministry
- Vatican and Church News
- Blessed Virgin Mary
- St. Francis of Assisi
- St. Michael the Archangel
- Catholic Online School
- Prayer Candles
- Faith Library Resources
- Liturgical Calendar

## Main Portal

- [Catholic Online - World's Catholic Library](http://www.catholic.org): Main portal for Catholic resources, news, and faith library content
- [Catholic Online Homepage](http://www.catholic.org/index.php): Homepage for Catholic Online library with saints, prayers, and resources
